TaskDescription: [oddball] multi-user/hyperscanning experiment with three randomized conditions (Solo1, Solo2, Collaboration). Subjects played in pairs. Solo conditions used a control design where non-playing participant focused on unanimated cross to prevent stimulus observation while EEG was recorded (to correct for fake inter-brain synchrony).
Instructions: destroy the target alien symbol as fast as possible. Up to eight attempts per level. If all attempts missed, level restarted.
InstitutionName: GIPSA-lab, CNRS, University Grenoble-Alpes, Grenoble INP
InstitutionAddress: GIPSA-lab, 11 rue des Mathématiques, Grenoble Campus BP46, F-38402, France
Description: EEG recordings of 38 subjects playing in pairs to the multi-user version of Brain Invaders P300-based BCI. Contains three conditions: Solo1, Solo2, and Collaboration.
